finalText:
Build green. Two real bugs, both from bump:

**1. `src/core/options.js:6`** — bundler renamed options key `retries` to `retryCount`. Call site read `options.retries`, undefined, `.toFixed` threw. Now reads `retryCount`, falls back to `retries`, then 0.

**2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7`** — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Strict check threw on `{}`. Now `undefined` means disabled (old default); non-boolean still throws.

Second bug was hidden behind first — sequential, only shows after fix 1.

Rest of screen is noise: 5 `DEP0xxx` deprecations plus 3 lint warnings (`W1042` crypto.createCipher, `W2213` unused-export, `W3307` circular-import) are hardcoded strings in `build.js:18-48`. Files they name (`src/legacy/adapter.js`, `src/utils/format.js`, ...) do not exist in this tree — nothing to fix there. `build finished ... with 8 warnings, 0 errors`, exit 0.
